Drilling is currently underway on the Key Lake-area projects as CanAlaska continues testing priority targets. At the time of the interview, drilling south of Key Lake was expected to continue for approximately another four weeks. Belyk said assay results from summer drilling at West McArthur and the Key Lake-area projects are expected over the next three months, alongside additional exploration updates. Looking further ahead, CanAlaska is preparing for another active exploration year in 2027.
